timing: after label-blind holdout retrieval and independent human review, before candidate verification, authorization, or any holdout metric computation
reason: Revision 2 conflated a calibration ranking artifact hash with the cross-split ranking policy hash and did not fully bind first-stage retrieval dependencies. It also allowed a one-shot receipt to be claimed before deep structural validation of all evaluator inputs.

changes.ranking_identity: Separates a canonical ranking-policy hash from calibration and holdout ranking-file hashes.
changes.retrieval_dependency_closure: Binds the retrieval configuration and all scripts used to materialize the frozen rankings against the original method commit.
changes.holdout_input_bindings: Binds the label-blind retrieval receipt, review packets, final independent-human adjudication, and V16/V17 frozen ranking artifacts.
changes.label_governance: Adds blind third-review adjudication materialization with exact reviewer-artifact hashes and explicitly forbids model-assisted holdout labels.
changes.one_shot_safety: Adds a structural, metrics-free validation pass before the immutable one-shot receipt can be claimed.
changes.baseline_semantics: Stores only label-blind V16 acceptance and selected-item decisions; final correctness is computed by the locked evaluator.
